summary: Public backend regression and mobile Expo login smoke test passed. Authenticated CRUD/RBAC and persistence flows remain unverified because no Google test account is available.
action_items: Provide a Google OAuth test account to verify authenticated user CRUD/status, AI toggles, RBAC, refresh persistence, and drawer navigation.
Consider rendering an explicit error state in SimplePage instead of silently swallowing server/country/interrogation API failures.
critical_code_review_comments: SimplePage catches API errors in its initial load and does not display an error state, so failures can appear as an empty screen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview loaded at 375x667 with google-login-button and no browser error scan findings. test_credentials.md confirms no Google test account. Initial pytest run skipped because shell env was not loaded; rerun with frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL mapped to EXPO_BACKEND_URL and all 8 tests passed.
rca_of_issue: Authenticated positive coverage cannot be executed without the required external Google credential; this is a test-environment limitation, not an observed app failure.
